summary: Stranded model pin after cross-region failover degrades routing to fallback variant
description: Issue summary: After a planned cross-region failover exercise for the dedicated pool serving StorApp Inc., a subset of tenant sessions were routed to a degraded fallback variant even though the customer's tenant pin was expected to remain bound to the promoted model version. Impact: ~8% of production requests for StorApp (steady traffic) returned responses from the degraded variant (lower quality / quantized variant) for ~45 minutes; customers observed higher latency and quality regressions. Environment: Dedicated pool (prod us-west) performing cross-region failover to eu-west due to maintenance. Model: rwd-chat-7b-v2 pinned for tenant storapp-42. Observed behavior: control-plane signalled a successful promote to eu-west, orchestrator reported pin handoff completed, but edge-proxy continued to route a subset of requests to a fallback (quantized) variant. No explicit unpin event for the tenant was present in the control-plane audit log. The issue surfaced during a canary-weight adjustment window after the failover and persisted until manual remediation.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Configure tenant storapp-42 with model pin to rwd-chat-7b-v2 in us-west. 2) Initiate cross-region failover (simulate maintenance: drain us-west, promote eu-west). 3) Observe routing during canary weight shift (10% -> 50% -> 100%) and health probe smoothing. 4) Inspect edge-proxy routing logs and control-plane snapshot versions. 5) Note that a portion of sessions are served by the degraded variant despite pin remaining in control-plane state.
logs: excerpt: [2026-03-12T08:21:02Z] orchestrator: pin_handshake tenant=storapp-42 seq=23134 status=COMMIT; [2026-03-12T08:21:04Z] control-plane: snapshot_publish id=23134 region=eu-west; [2026-03-12T08:21:10Z] edge-proxy[id=e-84]: route_eval tenant=storapp-42 pin_token=xxxxxx cookie_domain=redwood-internal trace=0x9f2 drop_to_variant=quantized-7b reason='route_cache_missing_snapshot' latency_ms=482; [2026-03-12T08:22:11Z] serving-runtime[node=sr-12]: variant_select tenant=storapp-42 selected=quantized-7b load=0.73
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: edge-proxy cache TTL + cookie-domain rotation left some fronted proxies with stale snapshot index after orchestrator commit, causing route evaluation to fall back to a degraded variant when snapshot lookup failed. Key findings: - Control-plane audit shows commit sequence 23134 for tenant storapp-42 and no explicit unpin. - Orchestrator emitted pin_handshake COMMIT but the edge-proxy logs show 'route_cache_missing_snapshot' for the same tenant within the commit window. - There were concurrent health-probe smoothing events (canary weight adjust) that caused orchestrator to temporarily signal degraded-route eligibility. - Correlation with a small batch of edge-proxies that had not pulled snapshot 23134 due to a transient S3 read error caused route-cache misses. - Tokenization delta between rwd-chat-7b-v2 and quantized-7b exhibited increased latency for affected sessions. - No model-serving nodes reported errors; this is routing-level divergence. Open questions: whether edge-proxy should block-route until snapshot confirmation or enforce a stronger reconciliation on mismatch. Related historical tickets: links to pin-handshake races (SUP-314159) and route-cache issues (SUP-4721).
resolution: Workaround applied (2026-03-12 09:03 UTC): support executed control-plane forced-reconcile for tenant storapp-42 and restarted the 6 affected edge-proxy instances to flush stale cache. This returned routing to pinned model and reduced incidents. Root fix plan: 1) Deploy a reconciliation patch to control-plane/orchestrator that marks a pending commit as 'blocked' until a quorum of edge proxies confirm snapshot pull (implement optimistic commit backoff). 2) Add exponential backoff and retries for edge-proxy snapshot pulls and emit clearer metrics when pulling fails. 3) Extend canary handshake window by 30s during cross-region handoffs. 4) Add a short-term mitigation which will auto-reconcile pinned tenants if route_cache_missing_snapshot is observed more than N times. Rollout notes: patch targeted for canary on 2026-03-20 in control-plane; orchestration PR opened. Customer follow-up: StorApp notified and given post-incident summary. No billing adjustments required; CS offered credits as goodwill.
